indexes.__comment: What's On asks for the events whose audience includes one of mine, from now on, soonest first. Firestore will not run that without this index - the emulator makes one up as it goes, so it only bites in production. Martin deploys it with the rules. Created live from the console on 8 Oct 2026, and this matches it.

THE FOUR KNOWLEDGE-BASE PAGES. These four indexes already exist in the live project and were not in this file. That is not a tidiness problem: `firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes` deletes what the live project has and this file does not, so a deploy would have taken all four away and the four pages would have stopped listing anything. Written here exactly as they are live - published ascending, createdAt descending - so a deploy leaves them alone. Do not reorder the fields: the order IS the index.
